page.layout: One block of text, centred: title lines from top to bottom, then a woodcut engraving (tree with banner "NON SOLUS" and a figure), then the imprint below; a library stamp at lower right (not transcribed).

main_text.l: Auctior, atque ita emendata, vt alia

page.notes: Woodcut engraving: tree with banner reading "NON SOLUS" and a standing figure, above a ground line; not transcribed as text. Manuscript letter "A" in the upper right corner and an oval library stamp at lower right are not printed text and are omitted. The date is printed in the old reversed-C form: clo Ioc XLII corresponds to MDCXLII; the first character of the date is read as the reversed C form and may be uncertain [?].
